item.coloph: gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las/ thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga phyi rabs kyi don du/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis mdzad pa'o// de nas rim par rgyud nas/ stong (stang) dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ sprul sku dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyi snyan du rgyud pa'o//

phyi rabs gshen gyi don du dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis mdzad pa'o// de nas rim par brgyud nas/ stong (stang) chen dmu rtsa (tsha) gyer med kyis/ sprul sku dbra btsun nam mkha'i snyan du rgyud (brgyud) pa'o/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan gyur cig/
